response.sql: SELECT p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS award_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats

assumptions.assumption: Each row in manager_award counts as one award record (ties are not collapsed). Inner join to player drops unmatched awards, and the share denominator is the total of matched records only. NULL and blank bats values each form their own group as they appear in the data (not merged together).

alternatives.interpretation: Treat NULL and empty-string bats as a single 'blank or missing' group.
alternatives.sql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS bats, COUNT(*) AS award_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '')
